{{Quote|And, if all this wasn't bad enough, now our ship has developed problems. Doors open when no one's there. Lights blink off.|Transmission from the captain of the ''Band Light''|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Band Light''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] suspected of [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] activities during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The vessel was commanded by a [[Unidentified captain of the Band Light|captain]] during the Imperial period, and the crew consisted of [[Nix (fringer)|Nix]]&mdash;who was second in command&mdash;[[Pend]], and [[Red (Band Light)|Red]]. The crew attempted to [[Scavenger/Legends|salvage]] a derelict [[Etti Lighter|''Etti''-class light transport]] in the vicinity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="ITT" /> by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the in-game databank therefore must have taken place by 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> and they began to [[Death/Legends|die]] in what appeared to be a series of accidents which were caused by at least one Imperial [[Terror Trooper]]. In the wake of the deaths of Nix, Pend, and Red, the ''Band Light''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]] decided to abandon the ''Etti''-class vessel. The captain soon noticed additional problems with the ''Band Light''&mdash;such as lights switching off and doors opening on their own&mdash;and then sent a transmission about the incident, which was intercepted.<ref name="ITT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Band Light'' was mentioned in the "Terror Trooper" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="ITT" />
